messages.content: An encoder has 2" (or less) input lines and n output lines?

The encoder you're referring to is likely a binary encoder. With 2^n (or less) input lines and n output lines, this type of encoder is used to convert binary information into a coded form. In this case, the 2 input lines would typically be used for a 2-to-4 line encoder or a 2-to-1 line encoder with enable, where n equals the number of output lines that represent the encoded binary value.
